text:
alice (PM): Quick sync — finalizing GA acceptance for Private deployment. Need decisions on SLA targets, docs, oncall/support model, monitoring signals, and pricing bands. Who's in for a short checklist? :spiral_calendar:

ben (SRE): I'm in. For SLA we need target SLO (availability + API success) + an error budget policy. Propose 99.9% for GA, evaluate moving to 99.95% after 2 quarters. We also need alerts for rising 5xx rate, latency p99 > 1s, and KV cache miss spikes.

carla (Docs): Can we lock the final feature matrix? Docs can't finalize runbooks until we know exact rollback and upgrade steps. Also need example configs for VPC/private keys and KMS flows.

dave (Eng): For rollback: runtime supports auto-fallback to lower-capacity model variant and cross-region failover. Need to document the policy and CLI. We'll tag telemetry with release_channel and deployment_id so SRE can slice it. Quick runbook snippet I'll add to PR: 

```
# emergency rollback
invoke rollback --deployment $ID --target-version v1.3.2
```

dev-rel-bot: CI: release branch integration tests are green: 142/145 passing (two flaky infra tests, one flaky auth). Artifacts uploaded: gs://redwood-release/artifacts/1772. :white_check_mark:

eva (Sales): A few enterprise prospects are asking for 99.95% in contracts. We should decide if we can offer that for Dedicated/Private with a pricing uplift. If not, we need clear guardrails in quotes and legal.

alice (PM): Proposal: GA baseline SLA = 99.9% for Hosted & Private self-serve. Dedicated enterprise tier: option for 99.95% SLA with ~20% premium + 24/7 phone support. Docs to publish: runbook, SLA page (metrics & measurement), and migration guide. Monitoring: synthetic checks every 1m + per-route dashboards. Support: standard 4hr P1 response for self-serve, 1hr for enterprise add-on. Pricing: public token/embedding pricing + reserved-capacity SKU and an "enterprise uplift" line item.

ben (SRE): Sounds reasonable. I'll create the Grafana dashboards, SLO definitions, and alert runbooks by EOD Friday. Need the final list of endpoints to instrument (alice/dave please confirm).

carla (Docs): I'll draft the runbook and SLA page once Eng drops the final rollback CLI and sample responses. ETA Wednesday for first pass. Will include example curl snippets and a short troubleshooting flowchart.

dave (Eng): Confirmed CLI and endpoints. I'll add example curl and sample logs to the PR tonight. Also adding a telemetry tag 'sla_tier' so metrics can be grouped by contracted SLA.

alice (PM): Great — action items: ben = dashboards + SLOs, carla = docs draft, dave = curl/snippets + telemetry tags, eva = update sales playbook & legal on uplift. Target: sign-off next Tue for GA gating. If any blocker pops up, flag here. :thumbsup:
